section: ER-02 Site conditions and design data
text: The Contractor is responsible for the transport of all plant to Site, including route surveys, permits for abnormal loads and temporary works, taking into account the 120 t bridge limits on the state road (ALP-OWN-GEN-001 section 3). Heavy components shall be landed through a temporary barge landing on the public coastal strip, designed, built, operated and removed by the Contractor; the Owner obtains the coastal permit (tie-in TP-M1).
title: Access and transport
